question: Can the last ten be cut, and present or ancient action restrained?
premises: let the last ten be cut — to restrain is indeed impossible
inference: Cutting the last ten fails; body-bound acts, new and old, resist restraint.
uncertainties: antyadasa (last ten) count kept per gloss
plain_english: Let the last ten be cut — to restrain is indeed impossible; there in the body, what other, today-born or ancient.
